------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A witch sealed her last spell with textbook RSA and hung it in front of an old
mirror. The mirror held her private key and would reflect (decrypt) whatever a
visitor held up to the glass, but it was cursed, and it had two rules:

  1. It would NOT reflect the sealed spell itself.
  2. It would NOT show any reflection that contained the spell's opening "BOO{".

The witch is gone, and the glass has gone dark, but the mirror kept a log of
every ciphertext ever held up to it. All numbers below are plain decimal
integers. A reflection is an integer; turn it into bytes to read it. The
sealed spell is the flag.
